title: aesculus glabra f. pallida
intro: Aesculus glabra f. pallida, commonly known as white horse chestnut, is a plant species within the Aesculus genus, characterized by its white flowers and pale bark. This plant has been traditionally used to support cardiovascular health, with its extracts exhibiting anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of white horse chestnut include flavonoids, saponins, and oligosaccharides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as vasculoprotective and anti-edematous effects. The health benefits of Aesculus glabra f. pallida may include improved circulation, reduced inflammation, and enhanced immune function.
